citations.claim: body slides on floor at y=0.5 touching floor directly into side face of low thin wall
body very close to wall side, gap only 0.027 before contact
body has penetrated wall side while still resting on floor with unchanged velocity
first violating step: body overlaps wall 0 by 0.164 beyond 0.15 limit

counterfactual.change: Changed bodies[0].e from 0 to 1 only; restitution makes body bounce/lift off floor at side impact instead of grinding into wall, removing penetration.

explanation: Body rests on floor (y=0.5=r) sliding left at vx=-4.08 into the vertical side face of a thin low wall (x in [0.7,4.3], y in [0.6,0.8]). Gap shrinks 0.318 (step60) -> 0.123 (step62) -> 0.027 (step63), then penetration -0.069 (step64) -> -0.164 (step65, violation). With e=0 the side impulse kills normal velocity but adds no separation, and simultaneous floor contact appears to dominate positional correction, so the side overlap is never resolved and the body grinds deeper each step instead of stopping.
vision_note: The red body moves left at floor level toward the right tip of a thin low grey wall. It contacts the tip around step 63-64 and then visibly sinks into it, overlapping the wall end by step 65 instead of stopping.
